verdict.rationale: Sierra's Explorer answers natural-language questions across thousands of real customer conversations. It also proactively delivers a weekly briefing on trends, emerging issues and recommendations, and Insights reports link straight into Explorer for AI-driven investigation of any data point. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing pages (e.g., how recommendations are generated, and whether insights extend beyond conversation data).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask any question about your customer experience in natural language, and Explorer identifies the answer across thousands of real conversations.
Explorer automatically delivers a weekly briefing on key trends, emerging issues, and recommendations — without you having to ask.
Click any data point on a report to launch Explorer and instantly investigate what's driving that trend.
